theme: Quiet in Toronto, a full day tomorrow.
greeting: A quiet evening in Toronto, Dan — today's calendar is clear, which leaves room for the two family decisions that have been sitting a while. Tomorrow starts early with the FinCity call and your ICGN stewardship talk, and ends on the flight home.

needsAttention.title: December break is weeks past its own deadline
needsAttention.detail: The all-four-kids trip over Dec 13–Jan 2 was meant to be shortlisted by Sep 30 and booked by Oct 15 — both gone. Holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year, so every day now costs options and price.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Your half (three quotes, term length, coverage amount) has been open since Sep 25. It's stuck on the target coverage amount and term — settle those two and the shopping moves.

needsAttention.title: Come back to Martin on the Valoris draft
needsAttention.detail: You told Martin Steindl this morning you'd review the proposal and draft agreement and circle back. The ICGN days will swallow the week if it waits, so block time before travel.

needsAttention.title: ICGN stewardship talk + 7 AM FinCity call
needsAttention.detail: You're speaking on stewardship at ICGN tomorrow and have a 7:00 AM Valoris×IMC/FinCity Zoom that's still only tentative — firm up the RSVP and have your talking points set tonight.

schedule.title: Valoris × IMC/FinCity call
schedule.detail: Zoom with the FinCity Tokyo team (tomorrow); your RSVP is still tentative

schedule.title: Flight home to Boston
schedule.detail: Porter PD2947, Toronto YTZ → BOS (tomorrow); online check-in is open

flagged.title: Deloitte partner wants to connect
flagged.detail: Trevor Nakka (Lead Client Service Partner, Deloitte) sent a LinkedIn connection request — an easy yes for the board and advisory network.
